Package httyd.battle

Class BattleClock

java.lang.Object
httyd.battle.BattleClock
public class BattleClock extends Object
The two game clocks: a short clock for the current turn and a total clock for each side. Only the side that is thinking uses time.

    • discard

      public void discard()
      Stops the running clock without charging the elapsed time. The GUI uses this while it plays the animation of a turn, because watching an animation is not thinking time.
